scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-blog lint && pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-admin lint

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-blog typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-admin typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-blog test && pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-admin test
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-blog build && pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-admin build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-blog test:e2e && pnpm --dir frontend/xlumen-frontend-admin test:e2e
